children.name: Butomus junceus Turcz.
children.description: Butomus is the only known genus in the  plant family Butomaceae, native to Europe and Asia. It is considered invasive in some parts of the United States.

children.name: Butomus umbellatus L.
children.description: Butomus umbellatus is a Eurasian plant species in the family Butomaceae.

children.name: Butomites cretaceus Velenovsky, 1889
children.description: A fossil-plant form-taxon known only from leaf impressions, established by J. Velenovsky in 1889 from the flora of the Bohemian Cenomanian (Late Cretaceous), collected at Vidovle and Lipenec in the Louny district, Czech Republic. The generic name Butomites reflects a presumed resemblance of the foliage to the living flowering-rush family Butomaceae, though the affinity is uncertain.
